SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LINE_LOCATION_ID, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS REVISION_NUM FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HIJI' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(STATUS ,'D') AS STATUS , NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO , NVL(TO_CHAR(LINE_LOCATION_ID) ,0) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , NVL(TO_CHAR(REVISION_NUM),0) AS REVISION , NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , NVL(BUYER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION ,' ') AS DESCRIPTION , NVL(BUYER_UNIT ,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE , NVL(CURRENCY_CODE ,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE , NVL(UNIT_PRICE ,0) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(ITEM_QTY ,0) AS ITEM_QTY , NVL(ITEM_AMT ,0) AS ITEM_AMT , NVL(ADD_DATE ,' ') AS ADD_DATE , NVL(RD_DATE ,' ') AS RD_DATE , NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID ,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , NVL(LAST_NAME ,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME , NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME ,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , NVL(LEGACY_PRNO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO , NVL(REQ_USER_NAME ,' ') ||' '|| NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME ,' ') AS REQ_USER_INFO , NVL(POSTAL_CODE ,' ') ||' '|| NVL(DELY_TO_ADDRESS ,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , NVL(ETC1 ,' ') || NVL(ETC2 ,' ') || NVL(ETC3 ,' ') AS REMARK , NVL(EMAIL_ADDRESS ,' ') ||'||'|| NVL(OFFICE_PHONE ,' ') ||'||'|| NVL(MOBILE_PHONE ,' ') AS HD_REMARK , NVL(LOCATION_DETAIL, ' ') || '^' AS IV_COLUMN FROM APPS.KEPPO, XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = LINE_LOCATION_ID AND KEY_2 = REVISION_NUM AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*' ORDER BY LINE_LOCATION_ID, REVISION_NUM
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
